verdict.rationale: Core verification actions (create applicant, run workflow, retrieve reports, configure webhooks, OAuth auth) are all documented as API-first operations, but Workflow Studio and Dashboard document configuration are explicitly described as no-code/UI-only tools 'without the need for developer involvement,' with no documented API to programmatically create or edit workflows or acceptance rules. Missing for 10: API endpoints for building/editing workflows equivalent to Workflow Studio, API for dashboard document-type configuration, and confirmation that all no-code UI settings are also API-configurable.
